title: Anybody ever play VR Defender Y3K?
author: ifarted70
selftext:
It was a flash based tower defense game back in the day. It's still around if you search for it, but I wanted to try to make my own heavily inspired version that would work on mobile. Right now though I don't have many friends that would be good play testers and I'd love some feedback on things like tower balance and overall difficulty.

Fair warning, the main menu is kinda fugly and the map maker is really clunky.

replies.author: ifarted70
replies.body: Oh yeah I almost finished just about everything I wanted to, although I never finished trying to polish it for release. I don't know how old the build is I have linked here, but I'll try find the last stable build I messed with and upload it probably to chatGPT sites, then I'll return with a link. I'm at work now though so might not be until tomorrow. But I would love feedback on the balancing and newer mechanics!

replies.author: ifarted70
replies.body:
https://vr-defender-y4k.seedlessmelon.chatgpt.site/

Should be playable start to finish, although there are some missing audio files, and some other ones are placeholder like the machine gun because I think it sounds awful. Upside is there is a separate SFX and music slider.

It's also playable on mobile, but the UI is a bit clunky imo. Desktop is best.
